First, the Planner asked WebSurfer to search for "Was I The Wave?" and got a result that it was released on April 26, 2011. That seems straightforward. Then, the Planner asked WebSurfer to look up "Kingdom Of Rock."

The problem is that "Kingdom Of Rock" has multiple releases, and without knowing which artist the user is referring to, it's confusing. The Planner tried to use the title-only approach, assuming the earliest one is from 2007, but that wasn't confirmed. 

So, the mistake here is that the Planner didn't correctly disambiguate between the different artists with the same album title. This led to confusion about which "Kingdom Of Rock" album to compare. The Planner should have cross-checked with more reliable sources or asked for clarification to avoid this ambiguity.

I think the key error is in step 5 where the Planner concluded that "Kingdom Of Rock" was released in 2007 without verifying it properly. This led to an incorrect comparison with "Was I The Wave?" which was actually released earlier.
